'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Todd Benard LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Todd Benard]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Todd
* '''Username:''' Bernard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
